paragraphs: Finalsite sells a platform covering the school experience online, from websites and mobile apps to communications, enrollment and marketing. The company says it has been helping schools connect with their communities since 1999.

Communication tools include mass notifications, newsletters, real-time chat and email automation. The platform also handles admissions, enrollment and tuition billing management. Marketing services cover strategy, digital advertising and search engine optimization.

Finalsite states that it works with more than 7,000 schools and districts in 119 countries. It reports over 500 employees. More than 30% of that team has worked in schools, according to the company. It also counts over 5,000 school districts across the United States among its clients. The client site advertises free onsite workshops for public school communicators.
